exact.general_rank_collision: For B={b_1,...,b_(r-1)} above beta>q and P_B=product B: D_(r,s)(0)=2*(P_B*beta*q)^(s+1)*V(B,beta,q)^2
exact.noncommuting_limits: I_r(H)=limsup_(s->infinity)max(1,partial_lambda log D_(r,s)(H))^(1/s); after any fixed larger simple prefix, I_r(H_epsilon)=1 for epsilon>0 and I_r(H_0)=beta/q>1
exact.open_target: Control the Xi/Phi determinant flux by a structural identity that preserves the rank-one cancellation, or obtain gap-adapted exponentially small remainders; fixed algebraic raw-moment asymptotics alone do not resolve the collision.

general_rank_audit.general_crossover: For any fixed larger simple prefix, s_cross=2*log(beta/epsilon)/log(beta/q)+O(1)

proof_boundary: This artifact proves the exact raw-Phi-moment to Taylor to logarithmic-moment transfer, the symmetric LP+ split identities, the exponential condition number of the high-shift determinant at a repeated leading atom, the same logarithmic crossover scale at every fixed collision rank, and the noncommuting collision limits. It does not prove a Xi/Phi-specific cancellation-preserving estimate, PF-infinity, Jensen hyperbolicity for zeta, RH, or Lambda<=0.

rows.claim: The Phi transform supplies normalized Taylor coefficients by exact even raw moments.
rows.proof_boundary: This is an identity, not an asymptotic estimate.

rows.claim: The Taylor coefficients determine every Edrei power moment through a triangular Newton recurrence.
rows.proof_boundary: Computing a high-shift determinant requires the recurrence through the same high order.

rows.claim: A symmetric split gives an LP+ family converging to a repeated factor at any fixed support rank.
rows.proof_boundary: Any fixed string of larger simple factors can be adjoined; the family is a conditioning model, not the Xi function.

rows.claim: The split and collision are quadratically close in coefficient and compact-open topology.
rows.proof_boundary: Multiplication by a common normalized LP+ tail preserves the O(epsilon^2) compact-open gap.

rows.claim: The logarithmic moments amplify the small symmetric split at high order.
rows.proof_boundary: For fixed n the gap is O(epsilon^2), but the estimate is not uniform as n grows.

rows.claim: At collision the leading rank-one terms cancel and expose the next atom.
rows.proof_boundary: The formula is Cauchy-Binet for residues 2*beta and q.

rows.claim: Entrywise reconstruction of the collision determinant is exponentially ill-conditioned.
rows.proof_boundary: Correlated structural formulas can evade this black-box condition number; independent algebraic remainders cannot.

rows.claim: At every fixed rank the split determinant contains a tiny top-subset term with a larger exponential base.
rows.proof_boundary: Every Cauchy-Binet subset term is positive.

rows.claim: At every fixed rank the high shift needed to resolve a gap diverges logarithmically as the gap closes.
rows.proof_boundary: The larger simple prefix changes only the O(1) term, not the beta/q exponential base.

rows.claim: The repeated model has an explicit exponentially growing determinant logarithmic flux.
For each fixed nonzero split, the largest distinct pair dominates and the logarithmic flux is only affine in s up to exponentially small terms.
rows.proof_boundary: The constants diverge as epsilon tends to zero, so this estimate is not uniform at collision.

rows.claim: Every fixed-rank all-shift collision indicator is discontinuous under compact-open LP+ convergence.
rows.formula: I_r(H)=limsup_(s->infinity)max(1,partial_lambda log D_(r,s)(H))^(1/s); after any fixed larger simple prefix, I_r(H_epsilon)=1 for epsilon>0 and I_r(H_0)=beta/q>1
rows.proof_boundary: This blocks promotion from any fixed collection of shifts or any nonuniform coefficient asymptotic.

rows.claim: A Phi-specific proof must preserve the determinant cancellation structurally or resolve it exponentially.
rows.formula: Control the Xi/Phi determinant flux by a structural identity that preserves the rank-one cancellation, or obtain gap-adapted exponentially small remainders; fixed algebraic raw-moment asymptotics alone do not resolve the collision.
rows.proof_boundary: No such uniform Xi/Phi estimate is proved here.

rows.claim: The gate separates an exact conditioning obstruction from the still-open zeta estimate.
rows.formula: exact transfer and collision barrier proved; Xi/Phi determinant-flux bound open
rows.proof_boundary: Nothing here proves PF-infinity, Jensen hyperbolicity for zeta, RH, or Lambda<=0.
